fact: The book's epigraph and repeated refrain is Proverbs 23:7, 'For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he'
Your worth in life is essentially a product of the use of your mind
Man is a unique creature and possesses unusual endowments; there is so much inside man
Only eternity, the author thinks, can reveal the total worth of the creature called Man
As a child of God you have what it takes to make the most out of life
If ordinary minds have produced the outstanding results we see today, God expects you to do better than that, to produce extraordinary results by the appropriate use of your God-given mind
If those who are not born again are still getting great results, imagine how much God is expecting from you
The state of your life is determined by the state of your mind
Your thoughts hold the key to your life
The author says he has been burdened by the dire need for mental enlargement through supernatural encounters in the body of Christ, and that this is the reason for the book
The stated purpose of the book is to help you discover that your destiny is in your hand
It is impossible to think one thing and produce another
A happy and productive life results from correct thinking
All the author is out to establish in the book is that through the appropriate use of your mind you can produce the changes you desire
You are not here on earth to live an ordinary life, but to be an example to multitudes, a path-finder here on earth, the envy of your generation
Through the book you will come to the point of personal power that overcomes fear and banishes worry and anxiety
Ultimately you will be open to the way of a better, grander, happier and richer life
By the time you are through reading the book you will accept full responsibility for your life, and will have results to prove that God's Word is true
Chapter 1 is titled 'Understanding The Mind' and its epigraph is Proverbs 4:23, 'Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life'
Biologically, the heart is the centre of life
The Bible reinforces that your mind acts as the pivot around which your whole existence revolves, as it is where thinking takes place
Success does not demand prayer and fasting as much as engaging your senses positively
Man's brain is the myth behind all his gains
Every gain in life is a result of the use of the brain
No one reigns in life without the use of the brain
It is the effective use of the brain that secures you a throne here on earth
Every star in life is essentially sense-made
Heights in life are results of insights inside of a man
Success is a product of the right use of the sense
No school has a Faculty of Success; it is the use of the sense that commands success
Supernatural intelligence calls for extreme attention
The mind is defined as a man's seat of feelings or thoughts, and the intelligence faculty of a man
The mind has the ability to think and reason
A mad man is not recognized as a person, only as a specimen
A mad man is not permitted to vote and cannot be voted for
A mad man is not reckoned with during census, meaning he is not counted as a human being
The mad man's problem is that he is mentally grounded, and by that situation he has lost his entire worth as a man
When you become mentally grounded you automatically become valueless

Many physically blind people are getting so much done in life, and many crippled people are accomplishing great feats, but this is not so for the mad: we have never read of any accomplishment by a mad man
At the point of insanity a man's entire dignity is eroded and his entire value is lost
Your mind is the factor that makes you relevant to the world; when it is out of place, your place in life is lost
Many Christians think the spirit of a man is more important than the mind, but the author says your mind is as important as your spirit
The proof that the mind is as important as the spirit is that you cannot be saved without your mind
John 1:12 is cited: 'But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name'
The place of belief is not the spirit, but the mind
To believe is a product of conviction, and believe can be defined as mental assent
Believing is paraphrased as 'Based on these facts, I agree' and 'I concur. I agree'
Your mind is the gateway to your life, and nothing gets to you without first passing through your mind
Proverbs 4:23, 'Keep thy heart with all diligence', is read as talking about paying absolute attention to your mind, because your mind determines your ultimate worth in life
We have an advantage in redemption when it comes to the mind: there is a marked difference between the mind of a saved person and that of an unsaved person
The two types of mind are the carnal mind and the spiritual mind

Romans 8:6-7 is quoted: 'For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace. Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be'
The carnal mind is what the carnal man possesses, and the spiritual mind is what the spiritual man possesses
The ultimate product of the carnal mind is death, whereas the ultimate product of the spiritual mind is life and peace
Every unregenerated or unsaved soul possesses a reprobate mind that makes him do silly things
Romans 1:28 is quoted for the reprobate mind: 'And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient'
One of the things that happen when one gets born again is the renewal of the mind
2 Corinthians 5:17 is the scripture cited for becoming a new creature: 'Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new'
If a carnal and unregenerated mind is capable of producing results, then a saved person has no reason under heaven to be complaining and murmuring about life
1 Corinthians 2:16 is cited for the mind of Christ: 'For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ'
New life is infused into a man's mind at redemption, making him supernaturally smarter than his peers
You have a spiritual mind at salvation, and the Bible describes it as the mind of Christ
Ephesians 4:23 is cited: 'And be renewed in the spirit of your mind'
Your mind was spirited at new birth

Romans 8:11 is quoted: 'But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you'
Your biological system, including your mind, was affected at new birth by the infusion of the Spirit of life, so your mind is now spirited or regenerated
You are a new person and belong to a strange class
At new birth your natural mind was exchanged for that of Christ
The order of what happened to your mind is that it was first regenerated, then it was spirited, and then it is delivered to you as a complete package qualified as the mind of Christ

John 1:3-5 is quoted of Christ: 'All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made. In him was life; and the life was the light of men. And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not'
Because you have the mind of Christ you have the ability to bring new things to being
You have what it takes to operate as a co-creator with God, because all the abilities of heaven is packaged inside you
You are called a divine think-tank, and you have what it takes to find your way out of any storm
The quality of your life is determined by the state of your mind; without your mind you have no worth
It is the use to which you put your mind that makes the world to mind you: they say 'Don't mind him!' because the man is not using his mind, but they will mind you when your mind is in productive use
Asked what he does with his time, the author replied 'I read and think', and as a result he does not waste too much energy
Before taking any step the author must have determined what it takes to get the result he is looking for
Every star is known to be a thinker, and every committed thinker is bound to be a star

The instruction is to stop running here and there, to sit down first and think before you start running around, and to calculate your steps so that when you take them you already know where you are going
If you are saved you are a unique human being: you have a regenerated mind, the mind of Christ, and a spirited mind
Because the Holy Spirit dwells in you, you also have One who quickens your mind
By the appropriate use of your mind, the author sees every crisis in your family, business or finances disappear
